# Capital Unique

> Australian non-bank lending and private capital advisory, led by John Codrington. Capital Unique structures finance for complex commercial, property and development scenarios where traditional banks move slowly or decline. Wholesale and commercial only — not a consumer credit provider (NCCP exempt; no Australian Credit Licence).

## What Capital Unique does
- Non-bank lending for business, commercial property, property development, construction and agribusiness
- Bridging and caveat finance for time-sensitive transactions
- Private capital and private credit structuring
- Principal-led: one decision-maker, end to end

## Who it serves
- Borrowers: business owners, property developers, builders, commercial and rural operators with non-standard or time-critical scenarios
- Investors: wholesale and sophisticated investors, family offices seeking private credit exposure
